info.title: Wenmar Open
info.description: Free vehicle data for auto repair shops: VIN decoding and a year, make, model, submodel and engine catalog. No API key and no account. Responses are plain JSON with no wrapper. Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`. Fields and endpoints are only ever added. One address may make 600 requests a minute.

get.summary: One make, with links to the maker's own pages where they are recorded.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: A make's id, name or alias.

200.description: The make. `links` is `null` when none are recorded.

get.summary: The data version, the vPIC release it came from, and when it was built.

Every model year of one model, newest first, each with its vehicle id
and the number of recall campaigns that may apply to it.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: A make's id, name or alias.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: A model's id or name.

200.description: The model years. `recalls` is `null` in each when this server holds no recalls.

get.summary:
Recall campaigns, newest first: every one, or those narrowed by make,
model, year, component, free text or country.
get.description:
Each campaign may apply to the vehicles it lists. A make or a model the
catalog does not have gives an empty list.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description:
Only campaigns that list a vehicle of this make: a name, an alias
or an id, as in `/v1/vehicles/models`.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Only campaigns that list this model: a name or an id. Needs `make`.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Only campaigns that list this model year.

parameters.name: component
parameters.description: Only campaigns whose component text contains this, in either case.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Only campaigns with this text in them, in either case: in the
campaign number, the manufacturer's campaign number, the
manufacturer, the component, the summary, the consequence, the
remedy, the notes, or the make or model of a vehicle listed. At
most 100 characters are read.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: `us` or `ca`. Left out: both, where the server holds both.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, up to 100. The default is 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the page before, unchanged.

400.description: `validation_failed`: `country`, `year`, `limit` or `cursor` is wrong, or `model` was given without `make`.

404.description: `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no recalls, or none for the country asked for.

get.summary:
Recall campaigns reported on or after a day, newest first, each with
the vehicles it lists.
get.description:
For an application that keeps a list of vehicles: ask once a day with
the day of the last answer, and compare `vehicles[].vehicle_id` with
its own. Each campaign may apply to the vehicles it lists.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
Only campaigns reported on or after this day, as `2026-09-01`.
Required.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: `us` or `ca`. Left out: both, where the server holds both.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description:
Only campaigns that list a vehicle of this make: a name, an alias
or an id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, up to 100. The default is 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the page before, unchanged.

400.description: `validation_failed`: `since` is missing or is not a day, or `country`, `limit` or `cursor` is wrong.

404.description: `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no recalls, or none for the country asked for.

get.summary: One recall campaign with every vehicle it lists.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Who published it: `nhtsa` or `tc` (Transport Canada).

parameters.name: campaign
parameters.description: The publisher's campaign number. Letters may be in either case.

404.description: `not_found`: no campaign has that number. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no recalls from that publisher.

get.summary: The NHTSA investigations that led to a recall campaign.
get.description:
Open and closed, oldest first. Most campaigns followed no investigation
and give an empty list, as every Transport Canada campaign does. The
campaign number is not checked against the recall data.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Who published the campaign: `nhtsa` or `tc` (Transport Canada).

parameters.name: campaign
parameters.description: The publisher's campaign number. Letters may be in either case.

404.description: `not_found`: that is not a campaign number. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no investigations.

parameters.name: scope

`light` (cars, MPVs and trucks; the default), `all`, or a vPIC

parameters.name: term

get.summary: One catalog entry by its stable id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id: year, make and model, then optionally submodel and engine, joined by underscores.

get.summary: NHTSA investigations that list a model year.
get.description:
By default only the open ones about a possible defect in the vehicles
listed. An investigation is not a finding that a defect exists, and it
lists a year, make and model, never one vehicle: `note` says so.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id. Investigations are listed by year, make and model; a submodel or an engine in the id is set aside.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
`open` (the default): only investigations that are open and about a
possible defect in the vehicles they list. `all`: every
investigation that lists the model year, closed ones and audit
queries included.

200.description: The investigations, newest first. An empty list when none lists the model year.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no investigations.

get.summary: Everything held for a model year, in one answer.
get.description:
A block this server has no data for is `null`. The `recalls` block
counts the campaigns that may apply to the year, make and model; it is
not a lookup by VIN.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id. The overview is of the year, make and model; a submodel or an engine in the id is set aside.

get.summary: Recalls that may apply to a model year.
get.description:
The list is for the year, make and model. It is not a lookup by VIN:
`may_apply` is always `true`, and `lookup` gives the official addresses
where a VIN can be checked.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id. Recalls are listed by year, make and model; a submodel or an engine in the id is set aside.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: `us` or `ca`. Left out: both, where the server holds both.

200.description: Recalls that may apply, newest first.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no recalls, or none for the country asked for.

post.description:
The answer is an array in the order asked. Each item is a decode, or the
error object a single request for that VIN would have returned.

With `?include=recalls`, each decode that reaches a model year of the
catalog also carries `recalls`: how many campaigns may apply to that
model year. It is a count for the year, make and model, never a lookup
by VIN.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description:
`recalls` adds to each decode the number of recall campaigns that
may apply to the model year it reaches. Left out: nothing is added.

200.description: One item per VIN, in order.

400.description: `validation_failed`: the body is not `{ "vins": [...] }` or lists more than 50, or `include` is not `recalls`.

404.description: `dataset_unavailable`: `include=recalls` was asked of a server that holds no recalls.

get.summary: Decode one VIN.
get.description:
Spaces and dashes in the VIN are ignored and letters may be in either
case. A wrong check digit is not an error: `valid` is `false` and a
warning says so.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: A 17-character VIN.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Use this model year instead of working it out from the VIN.

400.description: `invalid_vin`: wrong length or illegal characters. `details.suggestions` lists likely corrections.

404.description: `not_found`: no manufacturer is registered for the first three characters.

get.summary: Everything held for the model year a VIN decodes to, in one answer.
get.description:
The VIN only names the model year: `recalls` counts the campaigns that
may apply to it, and no public data says a recall applies to one VIN. A
VIN that decodes to no vehicle in the catalog gets `vehicle: null`,
every block `null` and the warning `no_catalog_vehicle`, not an error.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: A 17-character VIN.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Use this model year instead of working it out from the VIN.

404.description: `not_found`: no manufacturer is registered for the first three characters.

get.summary: Recalls that may apply to the year, make and model a VIN decodes to.
get.description:
This decodes the VIN and lists the recalls of its model year. It does
not look the VIN itself up, which no public data allows: `may_apply` is
always `true`. A VIN that decodes to no vehicle in the catalog gets an
empty list and the warning `no_catalog_vehicle`, not an error.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: A 17-character VIN.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: `us` or `ca`. Left out: both, where the server holds both.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Use this model year instead of working it out from the VIN.

200.description: Recalls that may apply, newest first.

404.description: `not_found`: no manufacturer is registered for the first three characters. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no recalls, or none for the country asked for.

BatchItem.description:
One answer of a batch: a decode, or the error a single request for that
VIN would have given.

DatasetInfo.description: One dataset the server holds beside the catalog.

as_of.description: The day the source was current.

attribution.description: The credit to show with this data. Empty when none is asked for.

label.description: The short name shops use, such as `2.0L Turbo` or `3.5L V6`.

EngineOption.description: An engine in the engine step.

preset.description: Whether the engine comes from this project's list instead of NHTSA.

vin8.description:
The characters in position 8 of a VIN that mean this engine and no
other for this model year, where the data settles it.

Entry.description: One vehicle of the catalog, down to whatever level was asked for.

id.description:
The stable id. It stays the same from one data release to the next
for as long as the names do.

summary.description: One line naming everything above that is known.
summary.example: 2019 Honda Civic Si, Manual, FWD, Sedan

vehicle_types.description: NHTSA's vehicle types for this model year, such as `Truck`.

code.description:
A stable code to branch on. One of `invalid_vin`, `validation_failed`,
`not_found`, `dataset_unavailable`, `method_not_allowed`,
`payload_too_large`, `uri_too_long`, `rate_limited`, `unavailable`,
`internal_error`.

details.description:
More about the error. Always an object; empty when there is nothing
to add.

message.description: A sentence for a person to read.
message.example: a VIN has 17 characters, this has 16

Investigation.description:
One NHTSA defect investigation. An investigation is not a finding that a
defect exists.

campaigns.description:
The recall campaigns it led to, as NHTSA numbers them. Empty when it
led to none, or to none yet.

closed.description:
The day it was closed. `null` while it is open, and for some old
investigations whose closing NHTSA's file does not record.

component.description: The components it names, as NHTSA words them, separated by `; `.

kind.description: The letters the number starts with.

kind_name.description: The kind in words. `null` for a kind with no name on file.

manufacturer.description: The manufacturers it names, separated by `; `.

match.description:
In an answer about one model year: how the investigation's vehicle
text reached that model. `exact`, `base` (it names a series or trim
of the model) or `curated`. `null` in an answer about a campaign.

models.description:
In an answer about one model year: the model names the
investigation lists that reached it.

open.description: Whether it was opened in 2010 or later and has no day closed.

summary.description: NHTSA's summary. It can be several thousand characters.

Make.description: A make in the make step of a vehicle form.

popular.description: Whether it is on the list of popular makes, which are given first.

MakeDetail.description: One make, with links to the maker's own pages.

oneOf.description: `null` when no link has been recorded for the make.

popular.description: Whether it is on the list of popular makes.

MakeLinks.description:
The maker's own pages, found by a person. An address that was not
found is `null`. They lead off this service and can move.

checked.description: The day every link was last opened by a person.

customer_line.description: The maker's telephone line for customers.

recall_lookup_url.description: Where an owner checks a VIN for open recalls.

service_info_url.description: The maker's service information site, where it sells access.

wmi.description:
The manufacturer code: three characters, or six for a low-volume
maker.

built_at.description: When the data file was built, in UTC.

data_version.description: The data release, such as `2026.09`. Also sent as `X-Data-Version`.

datasets.description:
The datasets served beside the catalog, such as `recalls_us`, by
id. Empty when the server has none. A route for a dataset that is
not listed answers `404` with the code `dataset_unavailable`.

vpic_release.description: The NHTSA vPIC release the data was built from.

Model.description: A model in the model step.

id.description: The model's id form. Unique within its make.

year_from.description: The first and last model year the model exists in.

ModelYearSummary.description: One model year of a model.

bulletins.description:
How many service bulletins are on file. `null` until this server
holds bulletins.

id.description: The vehicle id of the year, make and model.

oneOf.description:
How many recall campaigns may apply. `null` when this server holds
no recalls.

url.description: The model year's page on this site.

ModelYears.description: Every model year of one model, newest first.

may_apply.description:
Always `true`: a recall count is of campaigns that may apply to the
model year.

NamedId.description: A make or a model: its id form and its name.

Overview.description:
Everything held for one model year, in one answer.

A block this server has no data for is `null`: `specs`, `fuel`,
`fluids`, `tires`, `labor` and `bulletins` are `null` in every answer
today, and each is filled when its data arrives. A client must accept
an object there.

attribution.description: The credit lines the data's licences ask for.

oneOf.description:
What the VIN decoded to. `null` when the overview was asked for by
vehicle id.

`null` when this server holds no recalls. A count of `0` with a
day in `as_of` means none was found.

The model year. `null` when a VIN reaches no model year of the
catalog; every block is then `null` too.

OverviewDecode.description: What the VIN of an overview decoded to.

engine.description: The engine in short form, such as `2.0L`, when the VIN names one.

engine_settled.description: Whether the VIN settles on one engine of the catalog.

entry_id.description: The most specific catalog entry the VIN reaches.

valid.description: Whether the check digit, position 9, is right.

oneOf.description: The maker's own pages. `null` when none are recorded for the make.

page.description:
The model year's page on this site. `null` when the VIN reaches no
model year of the catalog.

OverviewRecalls.description: The recalls of a model year, in brief.

do_not_drive.description: Whether any campaign carries NHTSA's advisory not to drive.

may_apply.description:
Always `true`. A campaign lists a year, make and model; only the
manufacturer can say whether one vehicle is in it.

newest.description:
The three newest campaigns. The whole list is at
`/v1/vehicles/{id}/recalls`.

park_outside.description: Whether any campaign carries NHTSA's advisory to park outside.

url.description: The model year's recall page on this site.

Plant.description: Where the vehicle was built. `code` is position 11 of the VIN.

Recall.description: One recall campaign in a list.

built_from.description:
In an answer about one model year: the first and last build date
the campaign gives. Compare them with the date on the door sticker.

component.description: The component, as the source words it.

date.description: The day the campaign was reported.

do_not_drive.description:
NHTSA's advisory not to drive the vehicle until it is repaired.
`null` for a Canadian campaign: Transport Canada publishes no such
field.

match.description:
In an answer about one model year: how the campaign's vehicle text
reached that model. `exact`, `base` (the campaign names a series or
trim of it) or `curated`. `null` in a list that is not about one
model year.

mfr_campaign.description:
The manufacturer's own campaign number, which a dealer looks a
recall up by.

models.description:
In an answer about one model year: the model names the campaign
lists that reached it.

notification.description: Transport Canada's notification type, such as `Safety Mfr`.

park_outside.description: NHTSA's advisory to park outside, away from buildings.

summary.description: What is wrong, in the source's words.

url.description: The campaign's page on this site.

RecallAsOf.description:
The day each country's recall data was current. `null` for a country
this server holds no recalls for.

RecallCampaign.description: One campaign with every vehicle it lists.

as_of.description: The day this publisher's data was current.

oneOf.description:
How far the remedy had got when the manufacturer last reported to
NHTSA. `null` for a Canadian campaign, for a campaign with no
report on file, and on a server that holds no reports.
`null` for a US campaign and for a Canadian one with no French text.

may_apply.description: Always `true`: the campaign may apply to a vehicle it lists.

part_number.description: The manufacturer's part numbers, separated by commas.

url.description: The campaign's page on this site.

vehicles.description: Every vehicle the campaign lists, by make, model and year.

make.description: The make and model as the source words them.

match.description:
`exact`, `base` or `curated`; `null` when the model is not in the
catalog, as for most heavy trucks, buses and trailers.

vehicle_id.description: The catalog's id for the model year, when the model matched.

RecallCompletion.description:
The newest report of remedy progress a manufacturer filed with NHTSA
for a campaign. The counts are totals for the whole campaign at the end
of the period named, which may be years past. They say nothing of one
vehicle: check a VIN at the addresses in `lookup`.

as_of.description: The day NHTSA's report files were current.

period_from.description: The first quarter the report covers, as a year and a quarter.

period_to.description:
The last quarter it covers. The counts are as of the end of it. A
quarterly report has the same quarter in both.

remedied_percent.description:
`remedied` as a share of `involved`, in whole percent, rounded
down. `null` when `involved` is 0.

report_number.description: The report's number among those of its kind, from 1.

submitted.description: The day the manufacturer filed the report.

RecallCount.description:
How many recall campaigns list a model year, for each country. `null`
for a country this server holds no recalls for; `0` when it holds them
and none lists the model year.

RecallDecode.description: What a VIN decoded to, as far as recalls need it.

valid.description: Whether the check digit is right.

RecallFrench.description: Transport Canada's French text for a campaign.

RecallInvestigations.description: The NHTSA investigations that led to one recall campaign.

investigations.description:
Oldest first. Empty when the campaign followed no investigation,
and for every Transport Canada campaign.

url.description: The campaign's page on this site.

RecallList.description: One page of campaigns, newest first.

may_apply.description: Always `true`: a campaign may apply to the vehicles it lists.

next_cursor.description: Hand this back as `cursor` for the next page. `null` on the last.

RecallLookup.description:
Where to check one vehicle for open recalls. Neither government
publishes recalls by VIN as data, so no answer here can say a recall
applies to a VIN: these lookups can.

maker.description: The maker's own lookup by VIN, where one is on file.

nhtsa.description: NHTSA's lookup by VIN, for the United States.

tc.description: Transport Canada's recall search, for Canada.

RecallVehicle.description: The model year an answer is about.

id.description: The id of the year, make and model.

RecentRecall.description: One campaign of the recent list, with the vehicles it lists.

vehicles.description:
The vehicles the campaign lists: at most 200 of them. Every one is
at `/v1/recalls/{source}/{campaign}`.

vehicles_listed.description: How many vehicles the campaign lists in all.

RecentRecalls.description: Campaigns reported on or after a day, newest first.

may_apply.description: Always `true`: a campaign may apply to the vehicles it lists.

next_cursor.description: Hand it back as `cursor` for the next page. `null` on the last.

Safety.description:
Safety equipment as the manufacturer reported it: `Standard`, `Optional`,
or a system type such as `Direct`.

tpms.description: How tire pressure is monitored, as NHTSA words it, such as `Direct`.

Selection.description: The catalog's answer for one decoded VIN.

engine_id.description: The engine's id form, when the decode settles on one.

entry.description: The most specific entry the decode reaches.

submodel_id.description: The submodel's id form, when the decode names exactly one.

vehicle_id.description: The id of the year, make and model.

Submodel.description: A submodel: a trim, or a series where the data has no trim.

kind.description:
`trim` or `series` as NHTSA has it, or `preset` from this project's
own list.

VehicleInvestigations.description: NHTSA investigations that list one model year.

as_of.description: The day NHTSA's investigation file was current.

attribution.description: The credit lines the data's licence asks for.

investigations.description: Newest first. Empty when none lists the model year.

note.description:
That an investigation is not a finding of a defect and is not about
one vehicle. Show it wherever the list is shown.

VehicleRecalls.description: Recalls that may apply to one model year.

attribution.description: The credit lines the data's licences ask for.

may_apply.description:
Always `true`. A campaign lists a year, make and model; only the
manufacturer can say whether one vehicle is in it. Check the VIN at
the addresses in `lookup`.

recalls.description: Newest first. Empty when none was found as of the dates in `as_of`.

VinDecode.description: A decoded VIN. A field that could not be determined is left out.

base_price_usd.description: Manufacturer base price in US dollars, when NHTSA has one.

oneOf.description:
The catalog entry this VIN reaches, for prefilling a vehicle form.
Left out when the catalog cannot place the vehicle.

gvwr.description: Gross vehicle weight rating class, as NHTSA words it.

oneOf.description:
How many recall campaigns may apply to the model year. Only in a
batch asked with `include=recalls`, and only when the VIN reaches a
model year of the catalog.

valid.description:
Whether the check digit, position 9, is right. Many genuine VINs from
outside North America fail it.

warnings.description: Things to know about a decode that still succeeded.

VinRecallCount.description:
What a batch decode says of recalls when `include=recalls` is asked:
how many campaigns may apply to the model year the VIN decodes to.

do_not_drive.description: Whether any of them carries NHTSA's advisory not to drive.

may_apply.description:
Always `true`. The count is for the year, make and model, not for
the VIN: check the VIN at the addresses in `lookup`.

park_outside.description: Whether any of them carries NHTSA's advisory to park outside.

VinRecalls.description: Recalls that may apply to the year, make and model a VIN decodes to.

may_apply.description:
Always `true`. This is not a lookup by VIN: the list is for the
model year, and the VIN only names it.

oneOf.description:
The model year the recalls are for. `null` when the VIN does not
decode to a vehicle in the catalog; `recalls` is then empty and a
warning says so.

warnings.description:
The decode's warnings, and `no_catalog_vehicle` when the VIN names
no model year to list recalls for.

suggestions.description: VINs the caller may have meant.

tags.name: Vehicles
tags.description: Years, makes, models, submodels and engines, each step limited to what is valid for the steps before it.

tags.name: Recalls
tags.description: Recall campaigns from NHTSA and Transport Canada that may apply to a model year. Never a lookup by VIN: confirm with the manufacturer.

tags.name: Investigations
tags.description: NHTSA defect investigations that list a model year or led to a recall. An investigation is not a finding of a defect.
